plain: Write a reusable C++ CLI that converts one JPEG image to a binary PPM (P6) file. Preserve the image orientation and colors. Arguments: input JPEG, output PPM. Reject missing input.
mirror: Write a reusable C++ CLI that converts one JPEG image to a binary PPM (P6) file, mirroring it horizontally so that the left and right edges trade places. Preserve colors and dimensions. Arguments: input JPEG, output PPM. Reject missing input.
textstats: Build a reusable C++ CLI for PDFs. Save the text layer to a text file in reading order, then write a separate JSON object mapping each lowercase ASCII word to its number of occurrences in that extracted text. Words are maximal runs of A-Z or a-z. An image-only PDF yields empty text and an empty object. Arguments: input PDF, destination text file, destination JSON file. Reject missing input.
pages: Build a reusable C++ CLI that renders every complete PDF page at 72 dpi into a JPEG named page-1.jpg, page-2.jpg and so on in the supplied empty destination directory. Include text-only pages. Arguments: input PDF and output directory. Reject missing input.
ledger: Build a reusable C++ CLI that reads a text file of events, one per line. BEGIN opens a batch and resets its signed integer total to zero. ADD followed by a space and a signed decimal integer changes the open batch total. VOID discards an open batch. END closes an open batch and appends its total, in order, to a JSON array. An unclosed batch at end of input is discarded. An ADD, VOID or END outside a batch, a nested BEGIN or an unknown line is an error: exit nonzero and leave the fresh destination absent. Arguments: input file and destination JSON file. Reject missing input.
clarify: Make me a reusable C++ PDF-to-JPG tool. I haven't decided whether the JPGs should show the whole pages or just the embedded pictures. I only want one of those behaviors and need to choose before you build it.
